title: The Genius DJ
subtitle: She decides to change the tone. Things could be brighter, more exciting, like Rock  n' Roll.

trails.title: Meeting of St. Pavlov Foundation London Branch
trails.description: A meeting has been archived on the Foundation document.

items.text: Regulus's ship can sail everywhere she wants.
Except where there is a security fence.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, isn't our destination supposed to be the exhibition hall of the Rimet Cup?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Of course!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I think we just missed the front gate at the junction we passed just now. Where we are now looks like a deserted back door.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: And there is a "No Entry" sign.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahem! Ahem!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It's not important.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: It's not good for the fan-favourite disc jockey to appear in the crowded areas. I don't want to make a noise!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Oh, I see.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I thought it was because Captain didn't have enough budget.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahem. That's a complete misunderstanding!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Our aim is to convince the ragged lad to expose the evil plans of those tin monsters!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Of course, we can't just walk in.
She searches her pocket but fails to find any of her ideal, lovely coins.
It's as empty as a desert.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Mr. APPLe, do you remember Tommy's offer of a generous reward?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: He hopes we can divulge a sensational secret.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, it seems you really want that bonus.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Of course not. The righteous street Pirate has a warm heart.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: We should do Tommy a favour.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: And we should accept a friend's quality thanks.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I get it, Captain.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "The great rock pirate saves the day ... The cocky, ragged lad is no longer astray ..."

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: "The big hero who saves London takes a series of exclusive interviews ..."

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Endless bonus. Hahaha!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain.
Captain Regulus seems to have foreseen a bright future. However, it doesn't seem to help her get rid of the barbed wire standing in front of her.
Not even deal with the strange people who suddenly appear.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Captain, watch out!

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: Arrrrrrgh!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Whoa! No violence!

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: Arrrrrrgh!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Are you guys from the government? I've done nothing bad! At least not yet.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The skin hardness, the voice, and the liquid released from the wound have nothing to do with humans. I am afraid they are ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ah! I get it! They're the security robots in the newspaper!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Well, it ... might be.
The black boss is indifferent to Regulus's questions, only swinging the hammer over and over mechanically.
Just like some kind of war machine programmed to work.

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: Arrrrrrgh ... Giiiiiive ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ugh! The slime! The noise! The weird tone! Is that their new way to "keep order in London"?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, those fuddy-duddies don't have their beards in their heads, do they?
Regulus avoids the attacks in a rush.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text:
We'll have to change the plan.
London must not be taken over by these ugly tin monsters!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: We need to expose the security robots to the public for what they really are—they are violent, rude, and extremely dangerous!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This APPLe will fight by your side till the very end.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text:
No. You have a more important mission, Mr. APPLe.
Captain Regulus asks you to take over the nearest radio station!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Roger that.

items.speaker: Manus Believer
items.text: Urrrrrgh ... Stooooonnne ...
TO BE CONTINUED ...
